title: Ankara real Signal Collector pilot, stationary control and walking session

raw_preservation.raw_artifact_pattern: operator-supplied external Signal Collector V6 files; immutable SHA-256 recorded separately

collector.name: Signal Collector
hardware_requirements: operator SIM/eSIM permitted for the campaign
collector.automation: manual start/stop export; no unattended upload or cloud dependency
collector.licensing: operator-provided local collection; raw recordings are not redistributed

device.antenna_basis: built-in handset antenna; modem-reported values have no device calibration correction

coordinate.poor_position_action: retain source row and accuracy; exclude coordinates over the declared threshold from canonical geometry

operator.network_context: receive-side handset observation only; no operator-side transmitter data supplied
operator.consent_note: user-provided local field recordings; no operator-side access or site permission is inferred

measurement.censoring_limitation: empty or unavailable source fields remain missing; no detection floor is invented and no missing row is called censored
measurement.los_annotation_policy: unknown unless explicitly field-annotated; no model-derived labels
measurement.outdoor_annotation_policy: unknown unless explicitly field-annotated; no location-derived labels

detection.unavailable_representation: empty source field retained as missing
detection.invalid_representation: invalid source field retained as an import issue and excluded from the quantity row
detection.censoring_representation: not available in selected V6 export; do not substitute a floor

known_limitations: Real local field evidence from two sessions; repeated route observations are autocorrelated.

Receiver height is nominal 1.4 m AGL, supplied by the operator as user-estimated with an approximately 1.3–1.5 m carry range. The current schema has no user_estimated enum, so height_source is recorded as assumed; the handset was handheld/chest height and approximately constant relative to local ground while terrain changed. No correction is applied.

The manifest schema stores campaign session IDs but has no per-session motion-classification field. Session 1 is stationary_control and session 2 is walking_pilot in the evidence artifacts; default_motion_state remains unclassified.
Outdoor state and LOS/NLOS annotations were not supplied and remain unknown.
Built-in handset antenna and device response are uncalibrated.

The export contains conflicting serving indicators: registered=true cell snapshots all report connection_status=NONE, while separate events are labeled SERVING_CELL_CHANGED. The existing adapter emits no canonical observations from those snapshots.
The export does not establish complete serving-resource or neighbor context for radio-quality validation.
Planning inventory defaults are not transmitter truth and are not copied into measured observations.
No calibration or model parameter changes are authorized by this campaign.

personal_identifiers_excluded: precise route coordinates in tracked artifacts
privacy.raw_access: restricted local campaign custody; raw files remain at operator-supplied external paths
privacy.sharing_policy: tracked artifacts contain aggregate or pseudonymous evidence only; never publish raw files or precise receiver routes
